foodOn.label: dough

citation.source: FoodOn (foodon.org), an OBO Foundry ontology, CC BY 4.0. Matched via EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) search API against the live FoodOn ontology, verified 2026-08-19.

foodOn.note: The generic "dough" class, deliberately NOT FOODON:03540199 "yeast leavened bread doughs": this repo's dough.json structure.components is flour+water only (no yeast) -- CLAUDE.md's own documented "3+-input COMBINE gap" is exactly why simple_flatbread.json stays deliberately unleavened. Picking the yeast-leavened class would misrepresent what this entity actually models.
